picks.title: Rillet raises $100M Series C at $1B valuation — 2 years after emerging from stealth
picks.why_it_matters: A 2-year path from stealth to unicorn with doubled ARR signals that AI-native vertical SaaS (specifically accounting) is a validated category with strong growth potential for early-stage bets.

picks.title: OpenRouter is joining Stripe
picks.why_it_matters: Stripe acquiring AI infrastructure tooling validates the emerging 'AI middleware' layer as a strategic category and signals M&A appetite for startups building picks-and-shovels for AI developers.

picks.title: Behind the Curtain: The new existential threat to AI
picks.why_it_matters: Rising political opposition to data centers creates regulatory risk for AI infrastructure plays but opens opportunity for startups focused on efficiency, edge computing, and sustainable AI infrastructure.
